scope: Measured audio bars in Team Radio, replacing Talking text in the Talk button and current transmitter status

behavior.local: Sample gated microphone energy, excluding the generated start beep. Show only during authorized transmission.
behavior.received: Sample decoded incoming stream only for the current floor owner with connected, unblocked, unmuted playback.
behavior.silence: Five flat 3px bars; no decorative animation or random motion.
behavior.accessibility: Keep Hold to talk label and pressed state; participant meter has a stable accessible label and does not announce every sample.
behavior.limits: Own bars indicate microphone signal, not confirmation of remote delivery.

workBounds.lifetime: Visible attached radio page with an active floor only; cancel on hide, navigation, floor removal or teardown.

covered: RMS silence and energy response, clamping and isolated analyser disposal
Local floor/lease/microphone guards and exclusion of beep mix
Remote playback guards, analyser reuse and floor cleanup
Single 100ms timer; no presence writes; cancellation on hide, floor removal and destruction
validation.browser: Native Web Audio with generated test signal and actual meter helper; real global/component CSS and matching representative markup. Not a full authenticated Angular session.

deployment: User authorized deployment when ready. Hosting only after scoped commit and push; keep issue 92 open pending connection field validation.
